links.outcome: False positive and false negative rates of lung nodule detection before vs after AI implementation
links.effect: At Hospital A, false negative rate fell from 8.4% to 5.16% while false positive rate rose from 2.36% to 9.77% (P<.001); accuracy fell from 93.33% to 92.23% (A) and 95.27% to 92.77% (C).
links.quote: At Hospital A, the false negative rate decreased from 8.4% to 5.16% (χ<sup>2</sup><sub>1</sub>=9.85; P=.002), while the false positive rate increased from 2.36% to 9.77% (χ<sup>2</sup><sub>1</sub>=53.48; P<.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment impact of an AI-assisted diagnostic system on junior radiologist diagnostic performance and report modifications pre- and post-implementation, but does not test a specific safeguard or organizational deployment practice.
